## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue if applicable.

## Validation

List the checks actually run, device/Android version when relevant, and any skipped coverage. Include before/after screenshots for UI changes.

## Risks and documentation

Describe migration, playback, provider, or compatibility risks. Update affected documentation and the changelog. Preserve upstream notices and identify the license/provenance of imported code. Do not include credentials or private account data.
